description.p: RYsys Photobooth is a versatile photo booth application designed for desktop and web. It supports single captures, classic 4-frame strips, 2x2/3x3 grids, burst captures, animated GIFs, timed shutter, custom frames, real-time filters, PDF and PNG exports, and native direct printing.
Initial release of RYsys Photobooth with multi-mode capture, filters, custom frames, PNG/PDF export, GIF encoding, and printing.
